feature.title: AHA 2026 Becomes Medtech's Ground Zero: AI Rewrites Cardiac Care With Hard Outcome Data
feature.summary: This week's American Heart Association Scientific Sessions in Chicago has become the most data-rich medtech event of 2026, with two landmark randomized trials — Cleerly's PARAMOUNT and Heartflow's DECIDE registry — delivering real-world proof that AI-guided coronary analysis outperforms standard care in hard cardiovascular endpoints. Beyond cardiology, the medtech landscape is defined by a wave of genuine deployments: FDA-cleared sepsis AI is cutting hospital mortality by 18% across dozens of U.S. systems, J&J's OTTAVA surgical robot is now authorized and launching into ORs, and ambient AI scribes have crossed the threshold from pilot to standard clinical practice. The common thread is a shift from promising pilots to measurable, peer-reviewed outcomes — the bar the industry has long been asked to clear.

highlights.label: Biggest story
highlights.text: Cleerly's PARAMOUNT trial — the first randomized head-to-head of AI-guided coronary CT vs. stress testing — met its primary endpoint with a win ratio of 2.00 (p<0.0001), triggering far more preventive lipid therapy in the AI arm.

highlights.label: Key trend
highlights.text: AI cardiovascular imaging tools are graduating from diagnostic aids to outcome-changers, with both PARAMOUNT and Heartflow's DECIDE registry showing hard reductions in cardiac events, heart attacks, and unnecessary invasive procedures.

highlights.label: To watch
highlights.text: J&J's OTTAVA — the world's first table-integrated surgical robot — is entering a phased U.S. launch after FDA De Novo authorization, setting up a three-way competition with Intuitive and Medtronic's Hugo that will reshape the $20B+ robotic surgery market.

articles.title: PARAMOUNT Trial: First Randomized AI-QCT Heart Trial Meets Primary Endpoint at AHA 2026
articles.snippet: Cleerly's PARAMOUNT trial — enrolling 530 patients across 21 sites — randomized chest pain patients to AI-based quantitative coronary CT analysis (AI-QCT) vs. standard stress testing. At 180 days, plaque-guided care achieved a composite win ratio of 2.00 (95% CI 1.37–2.56, p<0.0001), with lipid-lowering therapy rising from 31% to 75% in the AI arm versus 32% to 47% in usual care.
articles.result: Win ratio 2.00; lipid therapy use jumps to 75% vs. 47%

articles.title: Heartflow DECIDE Registry: AI Plaque Analysis Cuts Major CVD Events 34%, Halves Heart Attack Rate at One Year
articles.snippet: Prospective DECIDE registry data, presented at AHA 2026, evaluated more than 6,000 well-matched patients and found Heartflow Plaque Analysis with Plaque Staging produced 34% fewer major cardiovascular events (cardiovascular death, MI, revascularization, or stroke) versus CCTA alone at one year. Additionally, approximately 50% of patients reached LDL-C goal by 90 days, compared to roughly 35% with CCTA alone.
articles.result: 34% fewer major CVD events; MI rate halved vs. CCTA alone

articles.title: FDA-Cleared Sepsis AI (TREWS) Cuts Hospital Mortality 18% Across Dozens of U.S. Hospitals
articles.snippet: Bayesian Health's Targeted Real-Time Early Warning System (TREWS), developed at Johns Hopkins and FDA-cleared in April 2026, is now deployed across dozens of U.S. hospitals including Cleveland Clinic, MemorialCare, and University of Rochester. The system detects sepsis 2–48 hours before clinical suspicion by integrating EHR data with continuous AI, and is associated with an 18% reduction in sepsis mortality rates and decreased length of stay.
articles.result: 18% sepsis mortality reduction; detection 2–48 hours earlier

articles.title: J&J OTTAVA Receives FDA De Novo Authorization — World's First Table-Integrated Soft Tissue Surgical Robot Enters Market
articles.snippet: Johnson & Johnson received FDA De Novo authorization for OTTAVA in July 2026, cleared for 10 general surgery procedures including gastric bypass, cholecystectomy, and appendectomy following a prospective multicenter clinical trial supporting safety and performance. The table-integrated design takes 30–50% less OR space than boom- or cart-mounted systems, with a phased launch now underway at select U.S. centers.
articles.result: FDA De Novo cleared; 10 procedures; phased U.S. launch underway

articles.title: Biozen BP1000 Presents AHA Data: First FDA-Cleared Cuffless, Calibration-Free Blood Pressure Device Validated
articles.snippet: Biozen's BP1000 — the first FDA 510(k)-cleared cuffless blood pressure device in the U.S. requiring no calibration — presented new performance validation data at AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 on November 7. The device uses fingertip oscillometry combining pressure and optical sensing to directly measure absolute systolic and diastolic blood pressure, with the company positioning it for integration across wearables and smartphones.
articles.result: First FDA-cleared calibration-free cuffless BP device; AHA validation data presented

articles.title: Ambient AI Scribes Move from Pilot to Hospital Standard: 15–83% Documentation Time Cuts Confirmed Across Systems
articles.snippet: A real-world prospective time-motion study published in JMIR Medical Informatics 2026 found ambient AI scribe use reduced documentation time by 15% per consultation and increased clinician eye contact with patients by 10.6%. Across broader U.S. health system deployments, physicians report up to 83% less note-writing time, and the VA is now expanding ambient AI to all VA medical centers in 2026 to serve over 800,000 veterans.
articles.result: 15–83% documentation time reduction; VA expanding to all medical centers

articles.title: AI-Enabled Medical Necessity Review Cuts Utilization Management Timelines, Results to Be Shared at HLTH 2026
articles.snippet: Telligen and MCG Health will present a real-world case study at HLTH 2026 (November 17) demonstrating that AI-supported medical necessity review improved efficiency and reduced review time while keeping clinical decisions grounded in evidence-based guidelines. The deployment represents one of the most detailed public disclosures of AI-driven utilization management outcomes to date.
articles.result: Reduced review time; improved efficiency; evidence-based decisions maintained

articles.title: Wearable Deterioration AI Predicts ICU Transfer and Cardiac Arrest 8–24 Hours Before Standard Hospital Alerts
articles.source: Stanford Medicine / ARISE Network (State of Clinical AI 2026)
articles.snippet: A hospital-based study highlighted in the 2026 State of Clinical AI report found that an AI model trained on continuous wearable vital signs predicted patient deterioration — including risk of ICU transfer, cardiac arrest, or death — up to 8–24 hours before standard hospital alerts fired (Scheid et al., Nature Communications, 2025). The system provided clinically actionable warning windows that standard monitoring entirely missed.
articles.result: Deterioration predicted 8–24 hours earlier than standard clinical alerts

articles.title: SS Innovations SSi Mantra Surgical Robot Surpasses 10,500 Procedures Across 200+ Global Installations
articles.snippet: SS Innovations' SSi Mantra robotic surgical system has now completed more than 10,500 surgeries and been installed in over 200 facilities across 11 countries, with approximately 2,100 physicians trained on the platform. AIIMS Delhi's surgical department alone reported more than 1,000 robotic procedures in just 13 months, making it one of the first Indian government hospital general surgery units to reach that milestone.
articles.result: 10,500+ procedures; 200+ installations; 11 countries; AIIMS 1,000 cases in 13 months

articles.title: Cluster-Randomized Sepsis Trial: AI-Enabled Abstraction Raised SEP-1 Bundle Compliance from 70% to 83%
articles.snippet: A mini-review of generative AI implementation outcomes published November 2, 2026 in Frontiers in Medicine cited a cluster-randomized sepsis-quality trial in which AI-enabled data abstraction and feedback increased compliance with the Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock Management Bundle (SEP-1) from 70.1% to 82.9%, a 13-percentage-point improvement. The same review found AI-generated notes reduced clinician documentation time by 0.36 hours per 8-hour shift in a stepped-wedge randomized trial.

articles.title: Intuitive Surgical Reports 11,710 da Vinci Systems Deployed Globally, Up 12% Year-Over-Year
articles.source: Intuitive Surgical Q2 2026 Results / Medical Robotics News
articles.snippet: Intuitive Surgical's Q2 2026 results revealed 11,710 da Vinci surgical systems in active use worldwide as of June 30, 2026 — a 12% increase year-over-year. Intuitive also showcased AI development at the Society of Robotic Surgery 2026 Annual Meeting, drawing on a dataset of more than 20 million da Vinci procedures to build real-time surgical guidance capabilities.
articles.result: 11,710 systems deployed globally; 12% YoY growth; 20M+ procedure dataset

articles.title: DarioEngage Digital Therapeutic Achieves 1.2% Greater HbA1c Reduction vs. Standard Diabetes Care Alone
articles.snippet: An FDA-cleared digital therapeutic, DarioEngage, was evaluated in a six-month trial in which patients using it alongside standard medication saw a 1.2% greater reduction in HbA1c levels compared to medication alone. In the broader digital therapeutics space, platforms targeting asthma and COPD are demonstrating adherence rates 22–28 percentage points above standard care, with Jabil's 2026 industry survey finding 50% of digital health products now in production — up from just 11% previously.
articles.result: 1.2% additional HbA1c reduction vs. medication alone in 6-month trial
